notes.title: 🔎ServiceIT - Early Access Sneak Peek🔍
notes.content:
[h3]⚡️Bzzzt!⚡️[/h3]

In less than 100 hours we will start our voyage in Early Access. What does it mean? We want to deliver you the best experience possible but we are quite a small indie studio. From now on we are going to listen to you the community of ServiceIT: You can do IT to your feedback, your opinions, and your ideas.

[b]Firstly we will answer probably the most important questions.[/b]


[h3][b][u]1. What's the price of the game?[/u][/b][/h3]

It's [b]12.99$[/b] and with [b]a launch discount of a minimum of 5%[/b] as we have passed 700 followers. Now is the time to go higher. 800 = 10%!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/b18ac7cfc8dab0c6ac4c521150e2e44b1b4be29a.png[/img]

[h3][b][u]3. What languages are in the game?[/u][/b][/h3]
Every language that you see on the Steam card of the game. If you can't find yours, write to us. Maybe we can add it later.

[h3][b][u]4. Will it have bundles with other games?[/u][/b][/h3]

Yes, quite a lot. The best to find them all is to type after the release on Steam "ServiceIT"

[h3][b][u]5. What will I get in Early Access?[/u][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771120/906d5519875f319ece9079f0ea6782184baed0f7.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] 🖱️ The first story arc will be available, dealing with the fight against an unknown hacker and the corporation behind him
[*] ⚡️ Over 20 missions that will allow you to develop the website
[*] 💻 7 courses that will teach the player the secrets of IT (courses: soldering [repairing boards], network management, course on repairing boards with THT elements, course on installing an operating system, programming course, server management course, terminal use course)
[*] 💵 Marketplace - where you can buy used, broken tiles and sell them at a profit after repairing them
[*] 💲 Opportunity to earn money by assembling motherboards
[*] 🖨️ Ability to interact with the printer and a hidden room on the main map
[*] ⭐️ Achievements
[*] ❤️ Our heart and love for games
[/list]


[h3][b][u]6. How will the game change through EA?[/u][/b][/h3]

Based on the fan feedback 
a) Gameplay improvements as the game and its community grows
b) More equipment
c) More Achievements
d) New mechanics
e) More into the story

It mostly depends on you, if you like it, we can make it.

[h3][b][u]7. Will we have a launch stream?[/u][/b][/h3]
Yes. It will start on the day of release.


Remember if you want to write to us, let us know a problem you are having or an idea. It's best to do it on the Steam forum or our [url=https://discord.gg/sMBT77MDrU]discord[/url] channel where we are non-stop monitoring.

If you still haven't done it, wishlist the game and get the best possible discount on release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2194730/ServiceIT_You_can_do_IT/

Have fun,
ServiceIT development team

notes.title: 🔧 Patch 1.0 🔧
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]
We've had a busy time lately with the release of the prologue and the first sets of patches...
Even more so, we wanted to [b]thank you[/b] for every feedback and bug report!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771120/e34b2bc597607007de267ab507285f866899e6b8.png[/img]

[b]There are many improvements and bug fixes in this update - here are the main ones[/b]:
[list]
[*]We have added a save for boards repairs and many other interactive elements in the game

[*]We have rebuilt the interaction system - from now on, objects should behave better and not pass through other objects, you can also interact with an object in your hand

[*]We have rebuilt the mission and tutorial system to eliminate most of the problems of playing through the game

[*]We rebuilt the soldering system - from now on it has a new UI and should be more intuitive (more changes coming soon)

[*]We have improved and smoothed out decor mode

[*]We have made improvements to the inventory and item storage system

[*]We have improved the system of moving the player and moving in the workstation - also added a switch to the power supply

[*]We have made improvements to the game's translations and UI

[*]We have added a shelf for your orders! We have also updated the list of crate's in the game

[*]We have made improvements to in-game lighting and performance optimization

[*]From now on you can sell smd components that are in boxes!

[*]A lot of minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

[b]A follow-up patch will be released in the near future, and will include:[/b]
[list]
[*]Further improvements to the save (the last ones!)

[*]New tutorial videos

[*]New interactions and a few surprises!
[/list]

💻 We encourage you to keep sharing the bugs you find and your suggestions with us - here or on our discord 💻

See you soon!
[i]CipherCraft team[/i]
